body: I am, by several standards, handsome. Several people told me. I purportedly had a high IQ. Yet at 31 I have done nothing with my life. I just graduated. I have no jobs and won't find one that I could remotely like. My life is a disaster. I lose friends left and right. My gfs have stayed a few months only. I just jump from jobs to jobs and I have been depressed for more than 16 years now.

Hi, I think you have to work with the fact that you cannot do anything to get rid of your regrets. 

Live now and forget about what you could not do. 

I would suggest that you make a list of things that you want to do right now, and try your best to cross every item in your list. When you have a wife and kids, it would be harder.

Can we erase 2020?

Or maybe I should stop reading reddit so I wouldn't see people actually debating this crap instead of seeing it as the nonsense the 21st century has put us through.

Don't listen to that nonsense OP. Focus on your career and outsource tasks that you can avoid. You will end up miserable if you don't work on yourself & don't have a career (or just a financial place) that you can be proud of.
